title: Trail Cam AI Label Confidence Drift
dataSources: iNaturalist observations (`inat:observation`), moth trap sessions (`mothtrap:session`), bat detections (`batdetector:pass`), and trail-cam label events (`trailcam:label`).
app: Backyard biodiversity telemetry from iNaturalist exports, moth-trap image batches, AudioMoth bat detectors, and trail-camera AI labeling pipelines sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trailcam:label
| stats avg(confidence) as avg_confidence min(confidence) as min_confidence by camera_id label
| sort 0 - avg_confidence
description: Ranks camera-label pairss by AI label confidence drift.
value: Confidence drift is a fast signal that one camera angle or lighting setup is eroding model quality.
implementation: Send AI label confidence drift events to `index=personal` and keep `camera_id` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of AI label confidence drift by camera-label pairs.
grandmaExplanation: It totals which camera-label pairss stand out most for AI label confidence drift.
